scope: Continuous texture SVG front/profile fallback, normalized strand resources, accepted recipe combinations and legacy output preservation only.

findings.problem: A valid saved continuous-hair recipe without optional fineFaceRecipe emits empty fiber paths. Continuous path detection sets d empty regardless of modern status, but instanced use markup only occurs inside the modern branch. The accepted older/non-fine branch then emits d="".
findings.reproduction: ensure new saved identity; remove only profile.fineFaceRecipe; resolve appearance; render headOnly front buzz/crew/afro using continuous recipe. These are valid recipe combinations, not malformed raw DTOs.
findings.expected: Accepted non-fine combinations retain visible nonempty fiber paths; either gate modern continuous instancing/path blanking together or implement correct resources in the supported branch. Preserve absent-continuous legacy bytes.
findings.requiredCoverage: Explicit valid v2/v3 continuous recipe cases with fineFaceRecipe present/absent, checking nonempty paths and resource closure.

findings.problem: Normalized resource instancing multiplies both coordinates by length*scale. Direct continuousHairStrandPath uses scale only for amplitude; its longitudinal terminal remains y+length. Callers already multiply length/dy by hairFiberShapeScale, so the instanced route applies individual longitudinal scale again.
findings.expected: Instanced and direct strand geometry agree for the same parameters including individual scale, or establish one explicit consistent parameter contract and adjust all callers. Preserve separate strand-width and pigment authority.
findings.requiredCoverage: Numerically compare every transformed resource vertex against direct helper points at scale extremes and intermediate positions; include gray/dyed strokes and width behavior.

independentChecks.coverage: Includes 384 unchanged historical front/profile hashes, label-independent modern coordinates, boundaries, malformed positions, five-style document budget, resource references and arranged concealment. These checks do not cover the two counterexamples.

independentChecks.probe: Accepted continuous recipe with optional fine-face recipe removed and numerical normalized-strand transformation equivalence.
independentChecks.result: Two concrete counterexamples reproduced; details in findings.
